Power Preprocessor test suite.

Every preprocessor and every model it accepts, plus control sweeps, a batch and a resolution pair. Every model named here has weights on this machine.

The seed control is fixed on purpose. Left on randomize it changes every run, which changes every node's inputs, so nothing is ever reused and the whole graph recomputes even when nothing changed.

What to look for: no node should answer a flat black or flat white frame except where that is the point, such as the confidence sweep at 0.95. In each sweep group every row should differ visibly from the row above it.
